Alternate World Ash (Japanese: のサトシ Alternate World Satoshi) is a recurring character who first appeared in The Gates of Warp!. He is 's counterpart from the .

==History==
 
In The Gates of Warp!, after traveling to an alternate world, and Chloe bumped into Alternate World Ash in Canalave City, leaving them confused. 

In the next episode, Alternate World Ash hugged Ash's Pikachu and revealed that his own Pikachu had devolved into Pichu and then reverted back into a Pokémon Egg due to the clash between and distorting space and time. Together, the group traveled to Sandgem Town, where they met Goh, , Alternate World Dawn, and Alternate World Professor Rowan at the Pokémon Center.

On Professor Rowan's suggestion, all of them decided to head to Spear Pillar on Mount Coronet to stop Dialga and Palkia. At the Spear Pillar, Alternate World Team Rocket revealed that they were the ones responsible for Dialga and Palkia's battle, all thanks to the Red Chain, which contains the power of . Alternate Ash and Ash tried to break the Red Chain, while, Goh, Dawn, Chloe, and their Alternate World counterparts battled Team Rocket. A surge of Dialga's power blasted Alternate Team Rocket off through a gate and turned Ash, his friends, and their counterparts into toddlers, and reverted all of their Pokémon into Eggs as a result. 

Ash decided that they should send out their feelings to Dialga and Palkia to make them stop, and Alternate World Ash suggested they do the same with Arceus as well, since it was the one who created Dialga and Palkia, and must have the power to return everything to normal. Reacting to the group's desperate pleas, a shining image of Arceus appeared from the Red Chain and made it disappear, finally stopping Dialga and Palkia's fight. The two Legendary Pokémon immediately started undoing the results of their battle and sent the group back to the Alternate World's Canalave City, where they returned to their normal ages. With everything back to normal, Alternate World Ash bid farewell to Ash and his friends, who returned back to their own world.

==Character==
Alternate World Ash's speech patterns are more meek and polite in comparison to his counterpart, similar to Alternate World Dawn. But just like the Mirror Ash, Alternate World Ash is a bit insecure and tends to cry a lot.
